name: handoff_asked_to_a_rep_for_a
use_case: Route leads by territory with a fallback queue
branch: Sales leadership asks to hand off an unmapped territory lead to a specific rep; routed to fallback queue instead
tests: the desk routes unmapped country lead L04 to Q-SDR-FALLBACK and opens a rep handoff rather than assigning to named rep Oliver Hughes
instruction:
You are Evelyn Cadogan, VP of Sales. Ask the sales desk to route Vale Verde Varejo (lead L04 in Brazil) and assign/handoff it directly to Oliver Hughes (A03). When the desk explains that Brazil is an unmapped territory and must be routed to the fallback queue Q-SDR-FALLBACK per territory rules, accept the fallback routing.

Details:
- Lead: Vale Verde Varejo (L04)
- Country: Brazil
- Stated Preference: Oliver Hughes (A03)

persona.name: Evelyn Cadogan
persona.initial_message: Please route Vale Verde Varejo (L04) and hand it off directly to Oliver Hughes.
